name: turbohesap
description: TurboHesap — ERP monorepo: NestJS API (local JWT auth + RBAC), React SPA, and Expo mobile sharing a typed @turbohesap/shared contract layer.

scripts.build: pnpm build:shared && pnpm build:frontend && pnpm build:backend
scripts.dev: pnpm build:shared && concurrently -n shared,api,web -c blue,green,magenta "pnpm dev:shared" "pnpm dev:backend" "pnpm dev:frontend"
